## What

Closes the classic-banner-after-C1 **franken tail** — the wound carried verbatim since R64 P4 (8 playtest specs, verbatim-measured OPEN each round) — with the pair R72's reflection mandated: **guard + named refusal together, or the half-fix ships**.

**Form (b):** the classic save refuses whenever  regardless of banner; the refusal is a NAMED receipt kind  whose gen column records the genC collision it refused. Zero state change — the player can flip back to the coev banner and save there, or train classic past the collision (honest divergence escapes the guard).

The wound, one last time:  writes the shared gen/champNet slots (R47 sync), so a C1-trained player flipping the dropdown to classic saved a file claiming  with  (identity) paired with the UNTOUCHED classic pop — the R56 P3/R59 M1 three-lineage class reborn in the classic writer.

## Proof

- **FAIL-first on the pristine r72 tip** (one run): T1/T4 RED (franken file downloads, bare SAVE receipt — wound reproduced exactly as carried), T2/T3 GREEN by design.
- **4 pins** driving the REAL shipped handlers VERBATIM (functions extracted from index.html, core.js as PQ, seeded randPQ): T1 FRANKEN-REFUSAL, T2 CLASSIC-ONLY BYTE-UNCHANGED (always-on-guard regression), T3 COEV-BANNER ISOLATION, T4 BOUNDARY ESCAPE (guard is collision-exact, no wider).
- Suite: baseline @ pristine tip 316/308/0/8 → post-change **320/312/0/8** (+4 pins), qa 8/8, README live count pin 328.
- Canonical post-R50 line **byte-exact** post-change (all 5 md5s; guard touches page glue only).
- r67 writer pin re-run **4/4** (same save-handler extraction — guard inert in every coev-banner path).
- Marker grep EMPTY; final suite ran AFTER the PLAYLOG edit (R71 lesson).

## Sizing

One guard line + 4 pin tests + registry/README/PLAYLOG. The coev branch is byte-untouched; the R68-era "stays OPEN" comment retires into the closure note.

## Context

- Stacks on  (PR #91, Casey-gated) per the R22-vs-r21 precedent.
- Sibling **PR #92** (c1-scaling-study-v0) studied: additive off main , no save-path overlap, no conflict. Its 3016-line scaling corpus becomes R74 spec item 4 (verify-and-pin — numbers-verified-by-running extends to siblings' receipts).
- PLAYLOG Round 73 carries the full receipt: v1 draw #9 (L0 2225 / L1 6400 new marginal, first 16h / L2 4919 — middle band firms to 3 samples), the three carried [S] items, and the R74 spec.
title: Round 73: franken-save guard + named refusal (R72 spec items 1+5, mandated pair)
